Why Choose Wood / Cedar Shingles for Your Salem Home?

Natural cedar shingles and hand-split shakes deliver authentic rustic charm, natural insulating R-value, and organic architectural elegance. In Salem, where homes have a median construction year of 1979, upgrading to wood / cedar shingles enhances curb appeal while ensuring full compliance with municipal building codes enforced by the City of Salem Community Planning and Development.
